name: Obsidian
tagline: A knowledge base that works on local Markdown files
description: Obsidian is a note-taking app that stores notes as local Markdown files. The app itself is free for personal use, but commercial use requires a Catalyst or Commercial license. It supports plugins, themes, and linking between notes to build a personal knowledge graph.
pricingNote: Free for personal use. Commercial license required for business use (2+ users).
